Then look up headphones in the electronics category, use the Sony XM5 option with product_id p_sony_xm5_blk to generate recommendations, choose the best recommendation, and check out 1 unit. Finally, send a high-priority app notification confirming that the hotel booking, weather notice, and travel-related product purchase are complete for user_01.
